title: Map Pack Reinstatement Binder
oneLiner: A local-business evidence binder that turns a suspended Google Business Profile into a clean appeal packet and verification-video shot list.

keyUx: Enter the suspension reason, current profile fields, address/service-area setup, NAP citations, licenses, utility bills, storefront photos, review-conflict screenshots, and prior appeal history; the product finds trust-signal conflicts, builds an evidence checklist, drafts appeal language, and creates a verification-video shot plan.

stitchPrompt: Design a desktop local-operations product called Map Pack Reinstatement Binder for local service businesses, storefront owners, franchisees, and local SEO agencies dealing with a suspended Google Business Profile. Users enter the suspension reason, current profile fields, address or service-area setup, NAP citations, licenses, utility bills, storefront photos, review-conflict screenshots, and prior appeal history; the app finds trust-signal conflicts, builds an evidence checklist, drafts appeal language, and creates a verification-video shot plan. Include a suspension reason intake, profile-field mismatch scanner, NAP citation and document evidence vault, competitor/report timeline lane, verification video shot-list builder, appeal packet preview, and lost-lead downtime meter plus agency handoff. Design direction: use an operator-dense aesthetic with compact audit tables, map-pin status chips, restrained charcoal and white surfaces, sharp amber risk accents, and a serious local-SEO war-room feel that prioritizes appeal readiness over marketing gloss.
